SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
  AND fish_date_doy >= 180
  AND fish_date_doy <= 212
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6
  AND fish_date_doy >= 200
  AND fish_date_doy <= 213
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
